summary: Aeries Technology filed an 8-K on the October 30, 2026 settlement agreement with Sea Otter Trading resolving outstanding maturity consideration under a November 2023 OTC equity prepaid forward. The company will pay $911,461 through escrow, replacing the prior letter-agreement schedule of a $100,000 initial payment plus $75,000 monthly principal and 7.5% interest, in exchange for return of 145,183 Class A shares pledged as collateral. Mutual general releases follow the share transfer and payment, terminating prior agreements. This is a debt/deal unwind, not an M&A event; watch for share-count normalization and liquidity effects.
